Strawberry and Spinach Salad
By: FoodnChef
Published: Thursday, November 5, 2015 - 12:03pm

Ingredients




For dressing:
¼ cup balsamic vinegar
¼ cup red wine vinegar
2 tbs honey
1 tea spoon mustard
1 tea spoon sugar
¼ cup olive oil
200 g spinach
200 g strawberry
1 tea spoon chia or poppy seeds
2 tbs pumpkin seeds
Salt and pepper

Preparation

1 Mix the ingredients for dressing: vinegar, honey and sugar, mustard, salt and pepper. 2 Mix everything thoroughly with olive oil. 3 Wash the spinach and wipe with a kitchen towel. 4 Remove the strawberry stems. 5 Leave the small berries whole, the big ones – cut in half. 6 Mix the berries with spinach and add 2 tbs of dressing. Mix it and taste. If necessary, add more dressing. 7 Sprinkle with chia and pumpkin seeds and serve. 8 P.S. a cup measurement is given for reference only. Take a measure (a glass, coffee spoon, table spoon) and try it, finding your most suitable option.

About

How to cook it – this symbol of summer with bright red strawberry and juicy green spinach? Follow reading and we’ll explain everything in details.
